title: Keyturn Host Payout Account: Schedule of Settlement Rhythm and Transfer Limits
content:
Each of the six schedules a Keyturn Host Payout Account may settle under carries its own rhythm, its own payability delay and its own limits on the size and number of transfers. The figures below are the terms of each schedule.

## Schedule of terms

| Payout schedule | Sweep rhythm | Delay after trip start | Weekly sweep day | Sweep cutoff hour | Smallest transfer | Largest single transfer | Transfers a calendar month | Standard transfer time | Same-day cutoff hour |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | As each trip completes | 3 days | Monday | 17:00 | 1.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 30 | 3 business days | 14:00 |
| Weekly Batch | Weekly | 3 days | Tuesday | 17:00 | 25.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | 5 | 3 business days | 14:00 |
| Express | Daily | 1 day | Monday | 15:00 | 25.00 USD | 15000.00 USD | 31 | 1 business day | 13:00 |
| Instant | Only when the host asks | 0 days | Monday | 23:00 | 10.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 60 | 0 business days | 22:00 |
| Fleet Settlement | Monthly | 0 days | Friday | 18:00 | 250.00 USD | 150000.00 USD | 2 | 2 business days | 15:00 |
| Reserve-Backed Settlement | Monthly | 0 days | Friday | 18:00 | 500.00 USD | 250000.00 USD | 1 | 2 business days | 15:00 |

## Reading of the columns

- **Sweep rhythm** is how often the account is swept.
- **Delay after trip start** is the calendar days after a trip starts before its earning becomes payable.
- **Weekly sweep day** is the day a weekly sweep runs; it bears on a schedule swept weekly.
- **Sweep cutoff hour** is the hour of the day, on the 24-hour clock, after which a sweep falls to the next run.
- **Smallest transfer** is the smallest sum the account will transfer, and **largest single transfer** the largest sum one transfer may carry.
- **Transfers a calendar month** is the number of transfers the account will make in one calendar month.
- **Standard transfer time** is the business days a standard transfer takes to arrive, and **same-day cutoff hour** the hour on the 24-hour clock after which a same-day transfer becomes a next-day transfer.

## Points of judgement

A Keyturn Express Payout Schedule account is swept daily, holds a trip's earning for 1 day from the trip's start, and cuts off at 15:00; a sweep reaching the desk at 14:59 on that schedule belongs to that day's run, and one reaching it at 15:01 belongs to the next. The Keyturn Reserve-Backed Settlement Schedule is the other extreme: one monthly sweep, 1 transfer a calendar month, a smallest transfer of 500.00 USD and a ceiling of 250000.00 USD on the single transfer that run carries.
